root_cause.text: The `pcpu_init_value` function in `kernel/bpf/hashtab.c` incorrectly uses `copy_map_value_long` to copy map values, which assumes the source buffer size is rounded up to 8 bytes, causing an out-of-bounds read when the source map (such as `BPF_MAP_TYPE_CGROUP_STORAGE`) has a value size that is not 8-byte aligned.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff replaces `copy_map_value_long` with `copy_map_value` in `pcpu_init_value`, and the commit message states that "pcpu_init_value assumes that all sources are rounded up to 8 bytes, and invokes copy_map_value_long to make a data copy... an OOB happens when the source has only 4 bytes while the copy size(4) is rounded up to 8."
